scope_note: This supplementary source register is NOT the canonical single-CID approved product ledger. Each form requires current supplier SDS/TDS/CoA and CAS/EC/form, concentration and regulated application review after customer contact. Do not auto-promote any variant to commercial ChemicalSubstance.sameAs.

zinc_sulfate.name: Zinc sulfate
zinc_sulfate.note: The monohydrate and heptahydrate are different forms and must not inherit anhydrous CID 24424 as a general product-variant sameAs. Offered feed-grade and source remain unverified.

citric_acid.name: Citric acid
citric_acid.note: CID 311 alone identifies only the anhydrous parent; do not treat the two hydrate states as a single supplied food-grade material.

calcium_chloride.name: Calcium chloride
calcium_chloride.note: Two independent CAS/CID pairs support the general anhydrous and dihydrate identities, but NOT 20-25%, 77-80%, 78-80%, food compliance or ice-melt suitability of any offered lot.

magnesium_chloride.name: Magnesium chloride hexahydrate
magnesium_chloride.note: Two PubChem records contain equivalent hexahydrate formula, but a record choice is not proof of marketed food/technical grade or provenance. The previous magnesium ion CID 888 is rejected.
